name: Brutal Politics
summary: Captain Pentigast fears Desolace’s victorious centaur clan will threaten Alliance strongholds. He seeks a clan’s friendship so the Alliance can learn how to defeat the centaurs.

sections.title: A Land at War
sections.body: Centaur clans wage war across Desolace. Captain Pentigast fears the victor will turn against Alliance strongholds, so he seeks a way to prevent that danger. The Alliance needs a centaur clan as a friend to learn how to defeat the others.

sections.title: The Magram
sections.body: The Magram fight the Gelkis, so attacking the Gelkis may win the Magram’s favor. Earn that favor, then find Warug in the Magram village in southeastern Desolace. Warug says killing Gelkis is how you become a friend to the Magram.

faq.q: Why does the Alliance want an alliance with a centaur clan?
faq.answer: Captain Pentigast fears the victorious centaur clan will threaten Alliance strongholds. The Alliance needs a clan as a friend so it can learn how to defeat the centaurs.

faq.q: How do you earn the favor of the Magram?
faq.answer: The Magram fight the Gelkis, so attacking the Gelkis may persuade them to consider an alliance. Warug says killing Gelkis is how you become a friend to the Magram.
Warug is in the Magram village in southeastern Desolace.
